column3: Model fallbacks act inside the failing generation: an afterResponse hook switches to the next capable owner fallback through conv.configure and rewords the failure so pi retries it there; account faults move at once, transient faults on the last retry, request faults and overflows never
column4: A fallback after the run failed (a commit observer plus a continue) left the thread reported failed and was resumed a second time by the orchestrator; inside the generation nothing fails. Walking forward through the order needs no streak state, and pi's attempt budget caps the requests at 7 per generation
